record.paper_title: TWISTED GGP PROBLEMS AND CONJECTURES, GGP IV
record.original_question: Develop a relative trace formula, analogous to the one used in the original Gan-Gross-Prasad setting, that can address the global twisted Gan-Gross-Prasad conjectures formulated in this paper.

evidence.quote: It is conceivable that one can develop a relative trace formula, as in the case of GGP, to address the global conjectures here.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $E/F$ be a quadratic extension of number fields with associated Galois involution $c$. Let $V$ be a finite-dimensional skew-Hermitian space over $E$, and let $U(V)$ be the associated unitary group, embedded in $\mathrm{GL}(V)$ (viewed as an $F$-group by restriction of scalars). For a cuspidal automorphic representation $\Pi$ of $\mathrm{GL}(V)(\mathbb{A}_F)$ and a cuspidal automorphic representation $\pi$ of $U(V)(\mathbb{A}_F)$, consider the global twisted Gan–Gross–Prasad period integral
$$\mathcal{P}(\varphi,\phi) \;=\; \int_{U(V)(F)\backslash U(V)(\mathbb{A}_F)} \varphi(h)\,\phi(h)\,dh,$$
where $\varphi\in\Pi$ and $\phi\in\pi$, and the associated conjectural identity relating the non-vanishing of $\mathcal{P}$ (and its refined value) to central values of an Asai-type $L$-function attached to $\Pi$ and $\pi$, together with the existence of a relevant pure inner form, as formulated in the twisted Gan–Gross–Prasad framework for the pair $U(V)\subset \mathrm{GL}(V)$ (and its Fourier–Jacobi analogue).

Construct a relative trace formula on $\mathrm{GL}(V)\times \mathrm{GL}(V)$ (and its mate on the unitary side, summed over relevant pure inner forms), with explicit geometric and spectral expansions and matching of orbital integrals via a suitable transfer and fundamental lemma, sufficient to establish the global twisted Gan–Gross–Prasad conjecture (in both its qualitative non-vanishing form and its refined Ichino–Ikeda-type form) for the pair $U(V)\subset \mathrm{GL}(V)$ over arbitrary number fields, in full generality (without unramifiedness or other local restrictions).
artifact.category_tag: Relative trace formulas and Gan-Gross-Prasad conjectures
artifact.status_search_result: A relative trace formula approach to the global twisted Gan–Gross–Prasad conjecture has been developed and applied: the twisted GGP conjecture for $U(V)\subset \mathrm{GL}(V)$ and its refinement have been proved under unramifiedness and local assumptions (e.g., for unramified quadratic extensions), but a complete relative-trace-formula proof in full generality remains open.

status_evidence.title: Twisted Gan-Gross-Prasad conjecture for unramified quadratic extensions
status_evidence.snippet: Using a relative trace formula approach, the twisted global GGP conjecture for U(V) ⊂ GL(V), as well as its refinement, is proved under unramifiedness assumptions.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress via RTF under local/unramified assumptions.

status_evidence.title: The global GGP conjecture for Fourier–Jacobi periods on unitary groups II
status_evidence.snippet: Comparison of the relative trace formulae for Fourier–Jacobi periods on unitary groups.
status_evidence.claim: RTF comparisons continue to be developed for GGP-type periods.
